caption:
Всяка рамка е манифест на стил.
Изразете себе си без компромис в One Optic.

✨ Визуалът е създаден с AI.
prompt: Dramatic spotlight portrait: saturated orange-to-red gradient backdrop with a hard circular pool of light and a soft shadow cast across the upper face and glasses, subject dressed in black with slicked-back hair, cinematic and moody, medium-format look, deep shadows. Calm dark lower area. Brand world: edgy urban Italian-Canadian glam, dark and bold. A charismatic man in his mid-30s, with a confident, slightly enigmatic gaze, stands against a dark, subtly textured urban background. A single, strong directional spotlight emphasizes the sculpted lines of his tailored, dark blazer and the distinctive frames. The mood is edgy, sophisticated, and urban. Any person is an invented adult who does not resemble any real person. The glasses in the new image must be IDENTICAL to the reference photo: same shape, colour, proportions, temples and small details; never change, redraw or invent logos. The glasses are large, sharp and clearly visible. Premium luxury-campaign photograph, natural realistic skin and hands, correct anatomy. Do NOT render any text, logos, watermarks or letters anywhere in the image; leave calm space for a logo as described. No extra eyewear.
